question: For the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O phase change absorbent at the optimal desorption conditions, what regeneration efficiency was reached, and after five absorption-desorption cycles what remained?
rendered:
[Amino-Functionalized Ionic Liquid Phase Change Absorbents for Efficient CO2 Capture, page 5]
At 393.15 K and 80 min, the rich phase was regenerated efficiently, with a regeneration efficiency of 94.7%. 

[Amino-Functionalized Ionic Liquid Phase Change Absorbents for Efficient CO2 Capture, page 5]
Under the optimized regeneration conditions, the cyclability of the absorbent was further investigated through five consecutive absorption-desorption cycles. As shown in Figure 6b, the regeneration efficiency remained at 88.6% of its initial value after five cycles, indicating that the absorbent maintains good stability after repeated regeneration.
